overview.title: Overview
overview.body: Owner API integration lets you call read-only report endpoints with a single API key. Typical use: schedule n8n workflows that fetch sales, cash, or inventory data per branch and send results to Sheets, Telegram, or email.

prerequisites.title: Before you start
prerequisites.step1: Generate an API key on the API Key tab and store it in a password manager or n8n credential.
prerequisites.step2: Note your branch IDs (shown below when loaded) — every request must include branchId.
prerequisites.step3: Confirm your n8n instance can reach the POS API URL (same host as VITE_API_URL / your deployed backend).

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.body: Send your owner integration key on every request. There is no OAuth — the x-api-key header is required.
authentication.apiKeyHeader: Your generated owner integration key (prefix pos_owner_).

endpoints.title: API endpoints
endpoints.intro: All routes are GET under /api/integration/reports. Use query parameters; branchId must match a branch you can access.

sales.title: Sales report
sales.description: Product-level sales totals for a date range with pagination.
sales.responseHint: Response includes items (rows), summary (totals), and meta (pagination).

cashSummary.title: Cash summary
cashSummary.description: Sales totals, expenses, payment breakdown, and cash-in-hand for a date range.
cashSummary.responseHint: Single JSON object with netSalesTotal, cashInHand, paymentSummary, expenseSummary, etc.

inventory.title: Inventory balance
inventory.description: Current stock levels by product for one branch (paginated).
inventory.responseHint: Response includes items, summary, and meta — same shape pattern as sales.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Same data as cash summary (alias route for dashboards).
summary.responseHint: Same JSON shape as cash summary.

n8n.setupIntro: Follow these steps in the n8n editor. Use Manual Trigger first to test; add Schedule Trigger later.

setupSteps.step1: Create a new workflow and add a Manual Trigger node (for testing).
setupSteps.step2: Add an HTTP Request node and connect it after the trigger.
setupSteps.step3: Open HTTP Request and set the fields in the table below (example uses the sales endpoint).
setupSteps.step4: Paste your real API key into the x-api-key header value (use n8n credentials if available).
setupSteps.step5: Click Execute workflow (or Test step) and confirm status 200.

output.step1: After a successful request, open the HTTP Request node and select the JSON tab in OUTPUT.
output.step2: For sales/inventory, the API returns one item with items, summary, and meta. n8n usually exposes this as a single item — use a Split Out node on items if you need one row per product.
output.step3: Use expressions in the next node to reference fields, e.g. totals from summary or netSalesTotal on cash routes.
output.paginatedNote: List endpoints return { items, summary, meta }. Cash/summary routes return a flat object with netSalesTotal and cashInHand.

automation.step1: Replace Manual Trigger with Schedule Trigger (e.g. daily at 9:00) when testing is done.
automation.step2: Add Google Sheets Append Row or Telegram Send Message after HTTP Request.
automation.step3: Map columns or message text using expressions from the previous step.

callout.readOnlyBody: Integration APIs cannot create orders, change stock, or modify users. They only return report data for branches linked to your owner account.
callout.n8nTipBody: Store the API key in n8n Credentials (Header Auth) instead of plain text in the node when possible.
